content.comment_body: Hello, I am configuring a [company_name] [product_name] as a Modbus Client to retrieve values from an inverter using Modbus TCP. I want to set the polling interval to 1 second (so it only reads new values every second to avoid unnecessary polling), but I can't find an option for adjusting the poll rate in Diagram Mode. Does anyone know where this setting can be found? I notice that Network Mode has a "Synchronize Interval" option—does this set the polling rate? Is there no equivalent setting in Diagram Mode?

If you use the remote function within the block properties, it's not possible to set the synchronization interval. I would recommend a different approach. Create a Modbus client connection via "Tools > Ethernet Connections". After the connection is established, double-clicking the connection opens up the connection table, where you can adjust the synchronization interval.
Thank you for the assistance. I will proceed with this suggested method.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced challenges when attempting to configure the polling interval for Modbus TCP communication in Diagram Mode with a [company_name] [product_name]. The discussion pointed out that user control over synchronization settings varies based on the mode and software workflow, indicating some usability gaps.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to be able to set the Modbus client polling rate directly within Diagram Mode and to easily find the appropriate settings for communication intervals.
